title: land's per-repository evidence names the request's own merge, not an unrelated later merge, for a fast-forwarded or rebased request
goal: bl_land.merge_commit names the request's own merge (or the branch tip for a fast-forward) even when an unrelated merge landed on the default branch after it; found by the SP-dqkf3i42 review at _tools/bl_land.py:961-974 (rev-list --merges --ancestry-path --reverse tip..upstream takes the oldest merge descending from the tip, which for a fast-forwarded tip is any later merge)
